summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled 727 KB obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script that runs `node setup.mjs`. `setup.mjs` downloads the Bun runtime binary from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<target>.zip`, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a shipped `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB single-line file marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` containing a shuffled string-array rotator (`WV8StW`), a large mixed numeric/string constant table (`n7gIxM`), and a custom-alphabet decoder (`hc1jfK9`) — i.e. a heavily obfuscated payload whose actual behavior is not visible to Node-based scanning because it is only executed under Bun. The advertised purpose is a React Native chart wrapper, which has no legitimate need to fetch an alternate JS runtime at install and use it to run an obfuscated bootstrap. The package is published under the `@servicetitan` scope at version 0.0.8 with a non-npm dependency reference to `@servicetitan/carto-charts-core@0.0.1`, consistent with namespace impersonation or a compromised release of a ServiceTitan-branded package. This matches the alternate-runtime-dropper install-time-RCE pattern: an obfuscated payload run by an alien runtime, triggered automatically by `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
